# P36.67 — Changelog, record-id diffs and /v1/changes (K13 TX-14)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/411_P36.67__changelog-record-id-diffs-changes-api.md` (manifest row 411, Round 11 / P36, sub-round 11C)
**Base:** `r11/P36.66b-site-snapshots-and-edge-selectors` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · `live_verification=false`

## Requirement ids stamped

- **SIG-TRANSP-024** (owned) — release diff + changelog: each release publishes an id-level diff against the previous activated release and a human changelog; `/v1/changes` is backed by it.
- **SIG-UI-087** (owned) — release pages free of `live`-clock values.
- Cited: **SIG-UI-039** (the T-page contract, where touched), **SIG-UI-040** (the ADR-155 page-type posture every route holds), **SIG-UI-076** (release-pinned only), the **SIG-REL-*** family (a changelog derives from two releases, never editorialises), **SIG-ENG-042** (an empty/unverified surface fails).

## What lands

- **`exports/src/exports/release_changes.py`** — the diff machinery: previous-release resolution (built dir / registry root / staged tree), the record-id-keyed per-compartment diff (`added`/`removed`/`changed` parquet under `r/<pub>/transparency/changes/`), the closed removal-reason classes with recorded bases, the declared compared-field set (**sources/confidence never compared** — J3 §8.4; claim anchors compare as an id set with the SIG-CONF-003 re-mint disclosure), the per-source `sig.release-source-changes/1` four-class diff (`not_evaluable` when the source inputs aren't presented), the `sig.release-changes/1` index, the `sig.release-changes-feed/1` `/v1/changes` doc, and `releases/<pub>/CHANGELOG.md`.
- **`release.py` / `cli.py`** — `build_release(previous_release=…)` + `--changes-against` / `--previous-publication` / `--previous-export-dir`; baseline (first release) when no previous is presented; `live`-clock enforcement at build **and** validation.
- **`release_pages.py`** — the landing's Changes section (totals + CHANGELOG.md + changes index links).
- **`api/release_serving.py` + `routes.py`** — `/v1/changes` serves the release's own `sig.release-changes-feed/1` doc through the same verified, withdrawal-checked path (`changes_document`); a pre-TX-14 release keeps answering its pinned `api/changes.json`.
- **`SIG-UI-087` lint** — the closed live-clock marker vocabulary scanned over every emitted `.html` under `r/` + `releases/`; a status-lane marker, next-run phrase or relative-time value fails the build and re-validation.
- **Tests** — `tests/exports/test_release_changes.py` (9) + `tests/api/test_api_release_changes.py` (5): fixture-diff totals, record-id keying, removal reasons, sources/confidence exclusion, determinism (byte-identical rebuild), baseline, `live`-clock refusals, feed serving + `since` filter, unknown/absent/withdrawn postures.
